page.layout: One column of running text, full width. Below the last line, at the right, "VIR.I"; below that, at the right, "AM-" as catchword. At the foot centre, "* 3" as gathering mark.

main_text.p: perfisimâ quondam Ve-strâ in eum voluntate, & singulari plane, ac tot illu-stribus probatâ documen-tis. Non de immenso illo, quod apud Vos, Vestros-que optimos Cives, reli-quit sui & relinquit cotti-die, desiderio. Animum tristissima hæc jam exulce-rat, acerbatque nimium recordatio. De me paucis-simis expediam,

page.notes: The first word is a fragment carried over from the previous page ("perfisima"), so it stays a fragment. "VIR. I" sits at the foot right of the last line; I have treated it as furniture and not as a heading. "* 3" is read as a gathering mark, not a page number, but the printed "3" also fits a page number. The catchword "AM-" is partly legible. The hyphenated line-end breaks are kept with their printed hyphens. Long s is written as plain s.
